installation: the release wheel in an environment outside the checkout
title: Cost of a complete design iteration: stage times, cold and warm, resident and streamed, broadband and sequential adjoint, autotuning break-even

workloads: one G7-01r3 robust design iteration (three wavelengths, TE)
fixture.synchronization: each stage bounded by a CUDA synchronization; overlapping asynchronous work is not summed
fixture.execution_policy: identical seed-1 CPU design input for resident and host-streamed adjoints; policy options recorded in every process. Resident uses 64 checkpoints. A predeclaration policy calibration chose the host-streamed 200-cell x slab, temporal depth 48 and 16 checkpoints; the global field state remains in host DRAM. The scene and objective are identical.
fixture.cold: first iteration of a fresh process
comparisons: one broadband three-frequency FDTD adjoint solve against three sequential one-frequency FDTD adjoint solves; all three gradients contribute to the same mean objective before one Adam update, including geometry, normalization and backward
fixture.tuning: policy autotuner cost and break-even iteration count

seed: the G7-01r3 and G7-03 seed 1 starts
reference_method: the recorded medians become the regression baseline

acceptance.stages: every stage recorded with median and range for cold and warm iterations
acceptance.comparisons: streamed and broadband/sequential adjoint comparisons recorded even where slower; a native tensor-batch result, if included, is labelled forward-only
acceptance.regression: a test flags a later run whose stage median exceeds 1.25 times the recorded baseline

supersedes.status: original case retained; its full-iteration tensor-batch comparison is technically unavailable in the released API

revision.reason: run_tensor_batch provides forward-only native Project cases and no backward path; the differentiable G7-01 design supplies explicit epsilon. RecomputedAdjointBatch replays cases sequentially and cannot be called a fused tensor batch.
revision.evidence: torchfdtd/tensor_batch.py, torchfdtd/adjoint_batch.py, docs/TENSOR_BATCH.md; D:/TorchFDTD/.local/g7_archive/G7-05/revision_proposal.md; installed-wheel development: one full G7-01r3 resident iteration and two host-streamed policies agreed in objective and gradient; the calibrated 200/48/16 host policy took about 5.9 minutes rather than about 55 minutes for the original 32/4/32 policy. These are not five-process judged timings.
revision.approval: Owner requested completion of the 1.0.0 release candidate through release deployment on 2026-09-27.

difference_from_first_case: Only the impossible whole-iteration tensor-batch comparison is replaced by the broadband-versus-sequential adjoint comparison. The original G7-01 workload is identified explicitly as the r3 robust design iteration for reproducibility; the later r4 segment design has a different mesh, duration and parameterization and is not substituted silently. Every stage, fresh-process repetition, storage comparison, autotuner item and 1.25x regression limit remains.
